rows.question: What is the current building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of the history department?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  TRIM(CONCAT(
    COALESCE(ba.STREET_NUMBER, ''), 
    CASE WHEN ba.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND ba.STREET_NUMBER <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(ba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, ''), 
    CASE WHEN ba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL IS NOT NULL AND ba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(ba.STREET_NAME, ''), 
    CASE WHEN ba.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL AND ba.STREET_NAME <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(ba.STREET_SUFFIX, ''), 
    CASE WHEN ba.STREET_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL AND ba.STREET_SUFFIX <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(ba.POST_DIRECTIONAL, '')
  )) AS ADDRESS,
  ba.CITY,
  ba.STATE,
  ba.POSTAL_CODE
FROM fclt_organization fo
JOIN fclt_building b
  ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN fclt_building_address ba
  ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE LOWER(fo.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History')
  AND ba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  AND ba.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = (
    SELECT MAX(ba2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE)
    FROM fclt_building_address ba2
    WHERE ba2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
      AND ba2.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  )

rows.question: Show the unique activity titles, locations, term start date, and supervisor name for all independent activities, sorted by the ascending order of start date.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS activity_title,
  COALESCE(s.SESSION_LOCATION, p.PERSON_LOCATION) AS location,
  t.TERM_START_DATE AS term_start_date,
  p.PERSON_NAME AS supervisor_name
FROM iap_subject_detail d
LEFT JOIN iap_subject_session s
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
-- join to persons so we can filter to the activity leader for that activity
LEFT JOIN iap_subject_person p
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
-- bring term start date
LEFT JOIN academic_terms t
  ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
WHERE (
    d.IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION = 'Independent'
    OR d.IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION = 'Yes - Independent'
    OR d.IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION = 'Independent Session'
  )
  AND p.PERSON_ROLE = 'Activity leader'
ORDER BY t.TERM_START_DATE ASC

rows.question: List the unique term code, subject title, room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code, formats, and number of enrolled students for all courses with more than 300 attendees.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  s.TERM_CODE,
  s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  s.MEET_PLACE AS room,
  s.FLOOR AS floor,
  s.MEET_PLACE_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
  addr.STREET_NAME AS street_address,
  addr.CITY AS city,
  addr.STATE AS state,
  addr.POSTAL_CODE AS postal_code,
  s.FORM_TYPE AS formats,
  s.total_enrolled AS num_enrolled_students
FROM (
  SELECT
    so.TERM_CODE,
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    -- MEET_PLACE and BUILDING key may be stored in different columns depending on table;
    -- use columns that exist in the provided schema: SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY has no MEET_PLACE,
    -- but library_subject_offered / tip_subject_offered have no room columns in schema either.
    -- The original query referenced "MEET_PLACE" and "FLOOR" from subject_offered which don't exist;
    -- instead take room/floor/building from space_detail joined by SUBJECT grouping via OFFER_DEPT_CODE where possible.
    -- To keep this query executable against the given schema, pick placeholders from available tables:
    -- we'll use MIN(space_detail.BUILDING_ROOM) etc by joining subject_offered_summary -> library_subject_offered -> space_detail.
    MIN(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS MEET_PLACE,
    MIN(sf.FLOOR) AS FLOOR,
    MIN(sd.BUILDING_KEY) AS MEET_PLACE_BUILDING_KEY,
    MIN(so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS FORM_TYPE, -- placeholder for "formats" since no format column exists
    SUM(COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled
  FROM subject_offered_summary so
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON so.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE
    AND so.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN space_detail sd
    -- there is no direct join key in schema between subject tables and space_detail; try matching dept code if available
    ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL
       AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.BUILDING_KEY -- best-effort join; schema lacks clear FK so this is a conservative guess
  LEFT JOIN space_floor sf
    ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY
  GROUP BY so.TERM_CODE, so.SUBJECT_ID, so.SUBJECT_TITLE
  HAVING total_enrolled > 300
) s
LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address addr
  ON addr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = s.MEET_PLACE_BUILDING_KEY
  AND addr.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'

rows.question: What are the subject titles, their material titles, ISBN numbers, and total costs of new materials for each subject title?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  tm.TITLE AS material_title,
  tm.ISBN AS isbn,
  SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_cost
FROM subject_offered so
JOIN tip_detail td
  ON (
       td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY IS NOT NULL
       AND td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
     )
  OR (
       td.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
       AND td.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
     )
JOIN tip_material tm
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
-- Only include materials marked as new. The schema uses NEW_SHELF_PRICE for new items;
-- ensure the material has a non-null new price to indicate "new".
WHERE tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE IS NOT NULL
  AND tm.ISBN IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(tm.ISBN) <> ''
  AND so.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  tm.TITLE,
  tm.ISBN
ORDER BY
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC,
  tm.TITLE ASC

rows.question: For each building key, what is the building name and the number of courses offered by the Center for International Studies?

  b.BUILDING_NAME,

      WHEN s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = 'CIS'
        OR s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'CIS'

    END

     AND s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL
     -- No direct building key available in subject_offered_summary, so prevent an unintended cartesian by requiring a matching building key field if present.
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM subject_offered_summary s2
       WHERE s2.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
         AND s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL
     )

rows.question: What is the name of the building that accomodates the most students, and how many students does it accomodate?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS `building name`,
  totals.total_students AS `number of students`
FROM (
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS total_students
  FROM subject_offered so
  JOIN fac_rooms fr ON fr.ROOM = so.MEET_PLACE
  GROUP BY fr.BUILDING_KEY
) AS totals
JOIN fac_building b ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = totals.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE totals.total_students = (
  SELECT MAX(t.total_students) FROM (
    SELECT
      fr2.BUILDING_KEY,
      SUM(COALESCE(so2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS total_students
    FROM subject_offered so2
    JOIN fac_rooms fr2 ON fr2.ROOM = so2.MEET_PLACE
    GROUP BY fr2.BUILDING_KEY
  ) t
)
ORDER BY totals.total_students DESC

rows.question: For each sponsor of the independent activity periods, list the sponsor name, number of sessions held, the total number of enrollment, the minimum and maximum fee, the number of sessions with info, and the number of sessions without info.

SELECT
  s.SPONSOR_NAME AS SPONSOR_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS NUM_SESSIONS,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.ATTENDANCE), 0) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT,
  MIN(d.FEE) AS MIN_FEE,
  MAX(d.FEE) AS MAX_FEE,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUM_SESSIONS_WITH_INFO,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ss.HAS_SESSION_INFO = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUM_SESSIONS_WITHOUT_INFO

JOIN iap_subject_detail d
  ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
JOIN iap_subject_session ss
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
JOIN academic_terms_all t
  ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
WHERE s.SPONSOR_NAME IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%IAP%'
    OR t.TERM_SELECTOR = 'IAP'
    OR t.TERM_CODE LIKE '%IAP%'
  )
GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME
ORDER BY TOTAL_ENROLLMENT DESC, s.SPONSOR_NAME

  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  COUNT(*) AS total_iap_sessions,

  MIN(det.session_max_enrollment) AS min_enrollment,

rows.question: What is the department name, total number of types of TIP subjects, total number of enrolled students, the minimum and maximum rental new price for each department?

SELECT
  COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS department_name,
  COALESCE(tip_stats.num_tip_subject_types, 0) AS total_tip_subject_types,
  COALESCE(enroll_stats.total_enrolled_students, 0) AS total_enrolled_students,
  tip_price_stats.min_rental_new_price,
  tip_price_stats.max_rental_new_price
FROM
  -- departments that appear in any source: TIP subjects, subject_offered_summary (enrollment), or tip_subject_offered (for prices)
  (
    -- departments from subject_offered_summary (enrollment)
    SELECT DISTINCT OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS dept_code FROM subject_offered_summary
    UNION
    -- departments from tip_subject_offered (TIP subjects / prices)
    SELECT DISTINCT OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS dept_code FROM tip_subject_offered
    UNION
    -- departments from student_department (to get names if present)
    SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE AS dept_code FROM student_department
  ) dept_keys
LEFT JOIN student_department sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_keys.dept_code
LEFT JOIN subject_offered_summary sos
  ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dept_keys.dept_code
LEFT JOIN (
  -- count distinct TIP subject types (distinct SUBJECT_ID in tip_subject_offered per department)
  SELECT
    OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS dept_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subject_types
  FROM tip_subject_offered
  GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE
) AS tip_stats
  ON tip_stats.dept_code = dept_keys.dept_code
LEFT JOIN (
  -- sum enrolled students per department, treating NULL as 0
  SELECT
    OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS dept_code,
    SUM(COALESCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM subject_offered_summary
  GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE
) AS enroll_stats
  ON enroll_stats.dept_code = dept_keys.dept_code
LEFT JOIN (
  -- min and max RENTAL_NEW_PRICE per department from tip_material joined through tip_subject_offered -> tip_material
  -- Schema links: tip_subject_offered contains TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY and may reference TIP_MATERIAL_KEY elsewhere;
  -- the clear table to get RENTAL_NEW_PRICE is tip_material. We join tip_subject_offered -> tip_material using TIP_MATERIAL_KEY if present.
  -- If the direct join key isn't present in schema, this will still work when TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY / TIP_MATERIAL_KEY relationships exist.
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS dept_code,
    MIN(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS min_rental_new_price,
    MAX(tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE) AS max_rental_new_price
  FROM tip_subject_offered tso
  JOIN tip_material tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL -- placeholder to ensure tm considered; actual join requires a key relationship
    -- The real schema does not show a tip_detail/junction table linking tip_subject_offered to tip_material.
    -- If such a table exists (e.g. tip_detail with TIP_MATERIAL_KEY), replace the JOIN above with:
    -- JOIN tip_detail td ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
    -- JOIN tip_material tm ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  WHERE tm.RENTAL_NEW_PRICE IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
) AS tip_price_stats
  ON tip_price_stats.dept_code = dept_keys.dept_code
WHERE
  -- keep only departments that have at least one of the sources (TIP subject types, enrollment, or prices) as requested
  tip_stats.num_tip_subject_types IS NOT NULL
  OR enroll_stats.total_enrolled_students IS NOT NULL
  OR tip_price_stats.min_rental_new_price IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  department_name

    WHEN 'JA' THEN 'JA'
    WHEN 'SP' THEN 'SP'

rows.question: List the building names, names of HR departments occupying them, the total gross square footage, the total and average assignable square footage, and the built year per building key.

  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  rd.hr_department_names AS hr_department_names,
  -- total gross square footage (use EXT_GROSS_AREA)
  b.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS total_gross_square_footage,
  -- total assignable square footage (use ASSIGNABLE_AREA)
  b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS total_assignable_square_footage,
  -- average assignable square footage per relevant record:
  -- if NUM_OF_ROOMS present and >0, use ASSIGNABLE_AREA / NUM_OF_ROOMS, else treat average as ASSIGNABLE_AREA
  CASE
    WHEN b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN b.NUM_OF_ROOMS IS NOT NULL AND b.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 THEN b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA / b.NUM_OF_ROOMS
    ELSE b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA
  END AS average_assignable_square_footage,
  -- built year extracted from DATE_BUILT which is expected in format %m/%d/%Y
  CASE
    WHEN b.DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR TRIM(b.DATE_BUILT) = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN b.DATE_BUILT REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{4}$' THEN RIGHT(b.DATE_BUILT,4)
    WHEN b.DATE_BUILT REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN b.DATE_BUILT

    FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS fclt_building_key,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME SEPARATOR ', ') AS hr_department_names
  FROM fclt_organization_hist

rows.question: What is the material status, term description, total number of courses and materials, occurences in departments and school, and the total number of instructors for each library material status code and term code?

  COALESCE(lso.TERM_CODE, frp.FISCAL_PERIOD, td.TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
  COALESCE(lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'Unknown') AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
  -- term description: prefer library_subject_offered term (if available) then frc_fiscal_periods description then tip term
  COALESCE(lso.TERM_CODE, frp.CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, td.TERM_CODE) AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  -- total distinct courses (by MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER + COURSE_NUMBER where available) per material status + term
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(
    COALESCE(lso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER, ts.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER, ''),
    '::',
    COALESCE(lso.COURSE_NUMBER, ts.COURSE_NUMBER, '')
  )) AS TOTAL_COURSES,
  -- total material records (library reserve detail rows + tip_detail rows)
  (COUNT(DISTINCT lmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY)
   + COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY)
  ) AS TOTAL_MATERIALS,
  -- occurrences in departments: distinct department codes from library_subject_offered and tip_subject_offered
  (COUNT(DISTINCT lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) + COUNT(DISTINCT ts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE)) AS OCCURRENCES_IN_DEPARTMENTS,
  -- occurrences in schools: distinct school names from library_subject_offered and tip_subject_offered
  (COUNT(DISTINCT lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) + COUNT(DISTINCT ts.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME)) AS OCCURRENCES_IN_SCHOOLS,
  -- total distinct instructors across both library_course_instructor and subject_offered responsibles and tip responsibles
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID)) AS TOTAL_INSTRUCTORS
FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lmd
LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
  ON lmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
  ON lmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
  ON lmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN frc_fiscal_periods frp
  ON lmd.TERM_CODE = frp.TIME_MONTH_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor lci
  ON lmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY

-- LEFT JOIN TIP-related tables to include tip materials in same result set
LEFT JOIN tip_detail td
  ON td.TERM_CODE = lmd.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN tip_material_status lms2
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered ts
  ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = ts.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY

-- try to bring subject_offered where available to get responsible faculty ids
LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
  ON ( (lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID)
       OR (ts.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = ts.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID)
       OR (lso.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID)
       OR (ts.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID)
     )

GROUP BY
  COALESCE(lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE, lms2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE),
  COALESCE(lso.TERM_CODE, frp.FISCAL_PERIOD, td.TERM_CODE),
  COALESCE(lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, lms2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS),
  COALESCE(lso.TERM_CODE, frp.CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, td.TERM_CODE)

rows.question: For faculty who are responsible for courses in 2023 fall term, list the name of mailing lists with ten members that they subscribe to, the number of faculty in these lists, and the number of courses associated with those faculty.

WITH faculty_courses AS (
  SELECT
    lso.TERM_CODE,
    lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    -- define a course identifier: combine master subject + master course number + course number (guard against NULLs)
    CONCAT_WS('-', lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, lso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER, lso.COURSE_NUMBER) AS course_id
  FROM library_subject_offered lso
  WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
    AND lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
-- compute actual membership counts per list (some rows in moira_list_detail may repeat members; use distinct)
moira_list_member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS distinct_member_count
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  GROUP BY mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
-- keep only lists that have exactly 10 distinct members and bring member rows for those lists
moira_10_member_lists AS (
  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  JOIN moira_list ml ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN moira_list_member_counts mc ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE mc.distinct_member_count = 10
)
SELECT
  l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS mailing_list_name,
  -- count distinct faculty members on the list who are responsible for >=1 2023FA course
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN l.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID END) AS faculty_count_on_list,
  -- count distinct courses (course_id) taught/owned by those faculty (only courses where faculty MIT id matches a list member)
  COUNT(DISTINCT fc.course_id) AS courses_count_for_those_faculty
FROM moira_10_member_lists l
LEFT JOIN faculty_courses fc
  ON fc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = l.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
-- only consider member rows that have an MIT id (can't match faculty otherwise)
WHERE l.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
HAVING
  -- ensure at least one of the list members is a faculty responsible for a 2023FA course
  COUNT(DISTINCT fc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) > 0
ORDER BY
  l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID,             -- MIT id if present

  FROM moira_list ml
  JOIN moira_list_detail mld
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY

  SELECT
    mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  JOIN moira_list ml
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  WHERE mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER IN (SELECT MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER FROM keeper_members)
),
enrollment_by_instructor AS (
  -- total enrolled students per instructor name (from library_subject_offered)
  SELECT
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS instructor_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS total_enrolled_students
  FROM library_subject_offered
  WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
),
publication_years_by_instructor AS (
  -- earliest/latest publication year for materials linked to subjects taught by instructor
  -- join library_subject_offered -> tip_detail -> tip_material
  -- note: tip_detail table is referenced in the original query but not listed in schema; assume it exists.
  SELECT
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS instructor_name,
    MIN(NULLIF(tm.YEAR,'')) AS earliest_publication_year,
    MAX(NULLIF(tm.YEAR,'')) AS latest_publication_year
  FROM library_subject_offered so
  JOIN tip_detail td
    ON td.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
  JOIN tip_material tm
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  WHERE so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
    AND tm.YEAR IS NOT NULL
    AND tm.YEAR <> ''
  GROUP BY so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
)
SELECT
  -- comma-separated distinct mailing lists the member subscribes to (including keeper-zephyr)
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT mal.MOIRA_LIST_NAME ORDER BY mal.MOIRA_LIST_NAME SEPARATOR ', ') AS mailing_list_names,
  km.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME AS instructor_name,
  -- publication year bounds (NULL when none)
  py.earliest_publication_year,
  py.latest_publication_year,
  -- total enrolled students (0 when none)
  COALESCE(eb.total_enrolled_students, 0) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM keeper_members km
LEFT JOIN member_all_lists mal
  ON mal.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = km.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
LEFT JOIN enrollment_by_instructor eb
  ON eb.instructor_name = km.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
LEFT JOIN publication_years_by_instructor py
  ON py.instructor_name = km.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
GROUP BY
  km.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, 
  km.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID,
  km.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME,
  py.earliest_publication_year,
  py.latest_publication_year,
  eb.total_enrolled_students
ORDER BY km.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME

rows.question: For the building with the most floors, list the building name and the names of the mailing lists staring with a (case insensitive) that the building employees with kerberos starting with c (case insensitive) subscribe to.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER AS mailing_list_name
FROM (
  -- compute num_of_rooms for each building by preferring fclt_building.NUM_OF_ROOMS, else buildings.NUM_OF_ROOMS
  SELECT
    bd.BUILDING_KEY,
    bd.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    bd.BUILDING_NAME,
    COALESCE(fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS, bd.BLDG_COUNTER, 0) AS num_of_rooms
  FROM buildings bd
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building fb
    ON fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = bd.BUILDING_NUMBER
) b
JOIN (
  -- determine the max number of floors/rooms
  SELECT MAX(COALESCE(fb2.NUM_OF_ROOMS, bd2.BLDG_COUNTER, 0)) AS max_floors
  FROM buildings bd2
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building fb2
    ON fb2.BUILDING_NUMBER = bd2.BUILDING_NUMBER
) mf ON b.num_of_rooms = mf.max_floors
-- employees in that building whose kerberos starts with 'c' (case-insensitive)
JOIN employee_directory e
  ON e.OFFICE_LOCATION = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
  AND e.KRB_NAME IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(e.KRB_NAME) LIKE 'c%'
-- mailing list memberships for those employees from moira_list_detail
JOIN moira_list_detail mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID
-- only mailing lists whose name starts with 'a' (case-insensitive)
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT MOIRA_LIST_KEY, MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
  FROM moira_list_detail
  WHERE LOWER(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) LIKE 'a%'
) ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
GROUP BY b.BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, ml.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
ORDER BY b.BUILDING_NAME, ml.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER

WITH course_base AS (

  SELECT

library_agg AS (
  -- aggregate library titles and isbns per term+subject using library_subject_offered -> library_reserve_catalog
  SELECT
    lso.TERM_CODE,
    lso.SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_TITLE) AS UNIQUE_LIBRARY_TITLES_COUNT,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(lrc.CATALOG_ISBN, '')) AS UNIQUE_LIBRARY_ISBNS_COUNT

  -- tip_subject_offered has TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY and MASTER_SUBJECT_ID; join on MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_ID and TERM_CODE
  SELECT
    tso.TERM_CODE,
    tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS TIP_UNIQUE_MATERIALS_COUNT,
    AVG(NULLIF(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE, 0)) AS TIP_AVG_NEW_PRICE,

  FROM tip_subject_offered tso
  LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  WHERE tso.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
),
cluster_enrollment AS (
  -- compute average enrollment within cluster type; subject_summary has CLUSTER_TYPE and SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER
  -- join subject_summary to restrict to Biology dept and get cluster grouping
  SELECT
    ss.TERM_CODE,
    ss.SUBJECT_ID,
    ss.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    ss.CLUSTER_TYPE,
    COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0) AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER

),
cluster_avg AS (

  SELECT
    CLUSTER_TYPE,
    AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS AVG_ENROLLMENT_WITHIN_CLUSTER

)
SELECT

rows.question: For subjects offered this year in either the Fall or Spring term, list its department name, school name, subject ID, subject title, course level, total units, the term it is offered ('Spring' for Spring term and 'Fall' for Fall term), term description, the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Fall, and the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Spring.

SELECT

  so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  so.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  -- use MASTER_SUBJECT_ID where present, otherwise fall back to COURSE_NUMBER (some tables have COURSE_NUMBER)
  COALESCE(so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, so.COURSE_NUMBER) AS course_level,
  so.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units,
  CASE RIGHT(so.TERM_CODE,2)
    WHEN 'FA' THEN 'Fall'
    WHEN 'SP' THEN 'Spring'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS term_offered,
  COALESCE(so.TERM_DESCRIPTION, so.TERM_CODE) AS term_description,
  COALESCE(f.instructors_fall, 0) AS instructors_fall,
  COALESCE(s.instructors_spring, 0) AS instructors_spring
FROM (
  -- unify columns from source tables; include keys so rows remain joinable
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    NULL AS COURSE_NUMBER,
    TOTAL_UNITS,
    TERM_CODE,
    TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    'subject_offered_summary' AS src
  FROM subject_offered_summary
  WHERE (IFNULL(IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR,'Y') = 'Y')
    AND RIGHT(TERM_CODE,2) IN ('FA','SP')

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    COURSE_NUMBER,
    -- use NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS as a proxy for units if TOTAL_UNITS not present

    TERM_CODE,
    TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    'tip_subject_offered' AS src
  FROM tip_subject_offered
  WHERE (IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL IS NULL OR IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N')
    AND RIGHT(TERM_CODE,2) IN ('FA','SP')

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    COURSE_NUMBER,
    NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TOTAL_UNITS,
    TERM_CODE,
    TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    'library_subject_offered' AS src
  FROM library_subject_offered
  WHERE RIGHT(TERM_CODE,2) IN ('FA','SP')
) so
LEFT JOIN (
  -- instructors in Fall per subject (distinct by MIT id or name)
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID),''), NULLIF(TRIM(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME),''))) AS instructors_fall
  FROM (
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, TERM_CODE FROM subject_offered_summary
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, TERM_CODE FROM tip_subject_offered

    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, TERM_CODE FROM library_subject_offered

  WHERE RIGHT(TERM_CODE,2) = 'FA'

    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, TERM_CODE FROM subject_offered_summary
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, TERM_CODE FROM tip_subject_offered
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, TERM_CODE FROM library_subject_offered
  ) all_so_s
  WHERE RIGHT(TERM_CODE,2) = 'SP'
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID
) s ON s.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE RIGHT(so.TERM_CODE,2) IN ('FA','SP')
ORDER BY
  department_name,
  subject_id,
  CASE RIGHT(so.TERM_CODE,2) WHEN 'FA' THEN 1 WHEN 'SP' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    -- use enrolled count from subject_offered_summary if present; fall back to library_subject_offered.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
    COALESCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0) AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM filtered_catalog fc
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = fc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered_summary sos
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
)
,
group_rows AS (
  -- per (material status, department) aggregation
  SELECT
    COALESCE(LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'Unknown') AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    COALESCE(OFFER_DEPT_NAME, 'Unknown') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,

    SUM(NUM_CATALOG_ITEMS) AS NUM_CATALOG_ITEMS,
    SUM(TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM group_rows

FROM (

  SELECT MATERIAL_STATUS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, NUM_CATALOG_ITEMS, TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
         1 AS sort_group, MATERIAL_STATUS AS sort_status, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS sort_dept, 0 AS is_subtotal

rows.question: For each course with enrolled students and with books in the library system, list the name of the department of that course, total number of courses using library materials, the number of catalog items associated with those courses, and the average enrollment per course. Include a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field should be 'Grand Total').

WITH courses AS (
  SELECT
    s.TERM_CODE,
    s.SUBJECT_ID,
    s.COURSE_NUMBER,
    COALESCE(s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS department,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0), COALESCE(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS course_enrollment,
    CONCAT(s.TERM_CODE, '||', s.SUBJECT_ID, '||', IFNULL(s.COURSE_NUMBER,''), '||', IFNULL(s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,'')) AS course_id,
    s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
  FROM subject_offered_summary s
),
course_catalog AS (
  -- link subject_offered_summary courses to library_subject_offered and reserve catalog items.
  -- library_subject_offered: has TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  -- library_reserve_matrl_detail and library_reserve_catalog tables are referenced in original query preview but not present in schema.
  -- The schema provided contains library_subject_offered and library_reserve_catalog only. To associate catalog items with courses,
  -- join library_subject_offered to library_reserve_catalog via TERM_CODE + SUBJECT_ID + COURSE_NUMBER + OFFER_DEPT_CODE where possible.
  SELECT
    c.course_id,
    c.department,
    c.course_enrollment,
    lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  FROM courses c
  JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON lso.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
    AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
    AND ( (lso.COURSE_NUMBER = c.COURSE_NUMBER)
          OR ( (lso.COURSE_NUMBER IS NULL OR lso.COURSE_NUMBER = '') AND (c.COURSE_NUMBER IS NULL OR c.COURSE_NUMBER = '') )
        )
    AND (lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = COALESCE(NULLIF(lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ''), lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) /* no-op to keep syntax */ 
         OR lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.course_id, '||', -1)
        )
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
    -- library_reserve_catalog has no direct course FK in schema; attempt to match by catalog fields is not possible here.
    -- Instead, treat each library_subject_offered row as indicating presence of library materials,
    -- and count NULL catalog keys as zero. Since there's no linking table in schema, we map catalog items only when keys match.
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY IS NOT NULL AND FALSE
  WHERE c.course_enrollment > 0
),
-- Because library_reserve_catalog cannot be reliably linked given the provided schema, adjust: count catalog items as 0 when unavailable.
dept_courses AS (
  SELECT
    department,
    course_id,
    MAX(course_enrollment) AS course_enrollment,
    -- If catalog key present in course_catalog use 1 per distinct catalog key, else 0.
    COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_items_for_course
  FROM course_catalog
  GROUP BY department, course_id
),
dept_agg AS (
  SELECT
    department,
    COUNT(*) AS total_number_of_courses_using_library_materials,
    SUM(catalog_items_for_course) AS number_of_catalog_items_associated_with_those_courses,
    SUM(course_enrollment) AS sum_enrollment
  FROM dept_courses
  GROUP BY department
)
SELECT
  department,
  total_number_of_courses_using_library_materials,
  number_of_catalog_items_associated_with_those_courses,
  CASE
    WHEN total_number_of_courses_using_library_materials = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(sum_enrollment / total_number_of_courses_using_library_materials, 2)
  END AS average_enrollment_per_course
FROM dept_agg

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Grand Total' AS department,
  SUM(total_number_of_courses_using_library_materials) AS total_number_of_courses_using_library_materials,
  SUM(number_of_catalog_items_associated_with_those_courses) AS number_of_catalog_items_associated_with_those_courses,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(total_number_of_courses_using_library_materials) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(SUM(sum_enrollment) / SUM(total_number_of_courses_using_library_materials), 2)
  END AS average_enrollment_per_course
FROM dept_agg
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN department = 'Grand Total' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  department ASC

rows.question: For each financial aid year and academic year, list the number of fiscal periods, quarters, the start term date, the end term date, and number of distinct department-level term parameters.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  tm.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR AS financial_aid_year,
  tm.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,
  -- number of fiscal periods associated with this financial aid year & academic year
  COUNT(DISTINCT tm.FISCAL_PERIOD) AS fiscal_period_count,
  -- number of quarters associated with this financial aid year & academic year:
  -- count distinct FY_QUARTER_CODE values from time_quarter where FISCAL_YEAR matches time_month.FISCAL_YEAR
  COUNT(DISTINCT tq.FY_QUARTER_CODE) AS quarter_count,
  -- earliest term start date for this financial aid year & academic year from academic_terms
  MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS start_term_date,
  -- latest term end date for this financial aid year & academic year from academic_terms
  MAX(at.TERM_END_DATE) AS end_term_date,
  -- number of distinct department-level term parameters for this financial aid year & academic year:
  -- count distinct TERM_PARAMETER from academic_term_parameter joined to academic_terms for the same grouping
  COALESCE(atp.distinct_term_param_count, 0) AS distinct_term_param_count
FROM time_month tm
-- join to time_quarter to bring in FY_QUARTER_CODE for counting quarters per fiscal_year
LEFT JOIN time_quarter tq
  ON tq.FY_QUARTER_CODE = tm.FY_QUARTER_CODE
-- join to academic_terms to get term start/end dates for the same financial_aid_year & academic_year
LEFT JOIN academic_terms at
  ON at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR = tm.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR
  AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tm.ACADEMIC_YEAR
-- pre-aggregate distinct TERM_PARAMETER per financial_aid_year & academic_year
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    at_inner.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
    at_inner.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COUNT(DISTINCT atp.TERM_PARAMETER) AS distinct_term_param_count
  FROM academic_term_parameter atp
  JOIN academic_terms at_inner
    ON atp.TERM_CODE = at_inner.TERM_CODE
  WHERE at_inner.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR IS NOT NULL
    AND at_inner.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    at_inner.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
    at_inner.ACADEMIC_YEAR
) atp
  ON atp.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR = tm.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR
  AND atp.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tm.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WHERE
  tm.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR IS NOT NULL
  AND tm.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  tm.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
  tm.ACADEMIC_YEAR
ORDER BY
  tm.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ASC,
  tm.ACADEMIC_YEAR ASC

rows.question: For each course in the current term, list the department, school, course number, subject title, total number of enrolled students, term code, and count of distinct catalog ISBNs. Add a summary row at the bottom showing the total number of students and distinct catalog ISBNs for the current term in the format of ('TOTAL:', null, null, null, total number of students, null, number of distinct catalog ISBNs).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH term_summary AS (
  SELECT
    s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS department,
    s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school,
    s.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_number,
    s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
    COALESCE(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,0) AS subject_enrollment_number,
    s.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    s.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id
  FROM subject_offered_summary s
  JOIN academic_terms a
    ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE
   AND a.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
),
term_isbns AS (
  -- gather distinct ISBNs for the current term via library_subject_offered -> reserve detail -> catalog
  -- Note: original referenced table library_reserve_matrl_detail is not in schema; assume library_reserve_catalog links directly to library_subject_offered via LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  SELECT
    lso.TERM_CODE,
    lso.SUBJECT_ID,
    lso.COURSE_NUMBER,
    lrc.CATALOG_ISBN
  FROM library_subject_offered lso
  JOIN academic_terms a
    ON lso.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE
   AND a.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  WHERE lso.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND lrc.CATALOG_ISBN IS NOT NULL
),
isbn_counts_per_course AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    COURSE_NUMBER,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CATALOG_ISBN) AS distinct_isbn_count
  FROM term_isbns
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_NUMBER
),
course_rows AS (
  SELECT
    t.department,
    t.school,
    t.course_number,
    t.subject_title,
    SUM(t.subject_enrollment_number) AS total_enrolled_students,
    t.term_code,
    COALESCE(ic.distinct_isbn_count,0) AS distinct_isbn_count
  FROM term_summary t
  LEFT JOIN isbn_counts_per_course ic
    ON t.term_code = ic.TERM_CODE
   AND t.subject_id = ic.SUBJECT_ID
   AND (t.course_number = ic.COURSE_NUMBER OR (t.course_number IS NULL AND ic.COURSE_NUMBER IS NULL))
  GROUP BY
    t.department,
    t.school,
    t.course_number,
    t.subject_title,
    t.term_code,
    ic.distinct_isbn_count
),
term_totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(cr.total_enrolled_students) AS total_students,
    -- count distinct ISBNs across the current term using term_isbns
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CATALOG_ISBN) FROM term_isbns) AS total_distinct_isbns
  FROM course_rows cr
)
SELECT
  department,
  school,
  course_number,
  subject_title,
  total_enrolled_students,
  term_code,
  distinct_isbn_count
FROM course_rows

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL:' AS department,
  NULL AS school,
  NULL AS course_number,
  NULL AS subject_title,
  COALESCE(tt.total_students,0) AS total_enrolled_students,
  NULL AS term_code,
  COALESCE(tt.total_distinct_isbns,0) AS distinct_isbn_count
FROM term_totals tt

rows.question: For each IAP category, list its name, number of unique sessions, total number of attendees, active period (in the format of 'beginning term code-end term code'), the most common sponsor name, and the most common session start time. Include a grand total row showing the total number of sessions and attendees across all categories in the format of ('TOTAL', number of sessions, number of attendees, null, null, null).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
-- most common sponsor per category (choose sponsor with highest count; tie broken arbitrarily by sponsor name)
mc_sponsor AS (
  SELECT
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(
      GROUP_CONCAT(sp.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY cnt DESC, COALESCE(sp.SPONSOR_NAME,'') SEPARATOR '||'),
      '||', 1
    ) AS most_common_sponsor_name
  FROM (
    SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM iap_subject_detail
    WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY IS NOT NULL
      AND IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
  ) dcounts
  JOIN iap_subject_sponsor sp
    ON dcounts.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
  JOIN iap_subject_detail d
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = dcounts.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
   AND d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = dcounts.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
  GROUP BY dcounts.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
),
-- most common session start time per category (choose start time occurring most often among sessions in the category)
mc_time AS (
  SELECT
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(
      GROUP_CONCAT(s.SESSION_START_TIME ORDER BY cnt DESC, COALESCE(s.SESSION_START_TIME,'') SEPARATOR '||'),
      '||', 1
    ) AS most_common_session_start_time
  FROM (
    SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM iap_subject_detail
    WHERE IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY IS NOT NULL
      AND IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  ) scounts
  JOIN iap_subject_session s
    ON scounts.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  JOIN iap_subject_detail d
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = scounts.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
   AND d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = scounts.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  GROUP BY scounts.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
),
-- aggregate per category (only include categories that have at least one linked session via iap_subject_detail)
category_agg AS (
  SELECT
    c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS num_unique_sessions,
    COALESCE(SUM(CAST(d.ATTENDANCE AS SIGNED)),0) AS total_attendees,
    CASE
      WHEN MIN(d.TERM_CODE) IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE CONCAT(MIN(d.TERM_CODE), '-', MAX(d.TERM_CODE))
    END AS active_period,
    mc_sponsor.most_common_sponsor_name,
    mc_time.most_common_session_start_time
  FROM iap_subject_category c
  JOIN iap_subject_detail d
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  LEFT JOIN mc_sponsor
    ON mc_sponsor.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  LEFT JOIN mc_time
    ON mc_time.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, mc_sponsor.most_common_sponsor_name, mc_time.most_common_session_start_time
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(num_unique_sessions) AS total_sessions,
    SUM(total_attendees) AS total_attendees
  FROM category_agg
)
SELECT
  IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  num_unique_sessions,
  total_attendees,
  active_period,
  most_common_sponsor_name,
  most_common_session_start_time
FROM category_agg

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS category_name,
  total_sessions AS num_unique_sessions,
  total_attendees,
  NULL AS active_period,
  NULL AS most_common_sponsor_name,
  NULL AS most_common_session_start_time
FROM totals

ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN category_name = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  category_name

rows.question: For each building type, list the name of the building type, the number of buildings that are not subdivisions, number of employees, number of unique building street address, number of unique city, number of unique state, number of unique postal code, and average gross square footage per employee. For building type of 'resident', display it as 'RESIDENTIAL'. Include a grand total across all building types (the corresponding type field is 'TOTAL').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY`,
    UPPER(CASE 
      WHEN `BUILDING_TYPE` = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL' 
      WHEN `BUILDING_TYPE` IS NULL OR `BUILDING_TYPE` = '' THEN 'UNKNOWN' 
      ELSE `BUILDING_TYPE` 
    END) AS BUILDING_TYPE,
    `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
    `BUILDING_NAME`,
    `BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS`,
    `BUILDING_COUNTER`,
    COALESCE(`BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`,0) AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  FROM `buildings`
),
e AS (
  -- match employees by OFFICE_LOCATION to BUILDING_NUMBER or BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS where possible
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    ed.MIT_ID
  FROM b
  LEFT JOIN `employee_directory` ed
    ON ed.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      ed.OFFICE_LOCATION = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
      OR ed.OFFICE_LOCATION = b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS
    )
),
addr AS (
  -- use building's street address as STREET; other address parts not available in schema, leave NULL
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY`,
    `BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS` AS STREET,
    NULL AS CITY,
    NULL AS STATE,
    NULL AS POSTAL_CODE
  FROM b
),
per_building AS (
  -- one row per building, with counts computed
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_TYPE,
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    -- determine if building is a subdivision by presence of hyphen in BUILDING_NUMBER (heuristic)
    CASE 
      WHEN b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR b.BUILDING_NUMBER = '' THEN 0
      WHEN b.BUILDING_NUMBER LIKE '%-%' THEN 0    -- treat hyphenated numbers as subdivisions
      ELSE 1
    END AS IS_NOT_SUBDIVISION,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.MIT_ID) AS NUM_EMPLOYEES,
    CASE WHEN addr.STREET IS NOT NULL AND addr.STREET <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS UNIQUE_STREET_ADDR,
    0 AS UNIQUE_CITY,
    0 AS UNIQUE_STATE,
    0 AS UNIQUE_POSTAL
  FROM b
  LEFT JOIN e ON e.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN addr ON addr.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY
    b.BUILDING_TYPE,
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    addr.STREET
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(per.BUILDING_TYPE, 'TOTAL') AS BUILDING_TYPE,
    SUM(per.IS_NOT_SUBDIVISION) AS NUM_NOT_SUBDIVISIONS,
    SUM(per.NUM_EMPLOYEES) AS NUM_EMPLOYEES,
    SUM(per.UNIQUE_STREET_ADDR) AS NUM_UNIQUE_STREET_ADDR,
    SUM(per.UNIQUE_CITY) AS NUM_UNIQUE_CITY,
    SUM(per.UNIQUE_STATE) AS NUM_UNIQUE_STATE,
    SUM(per.UNIQUE_POSTAL) AS NUM_UNIQUE_POSTAL,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(per.NUM_EMPLOYEES) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE ROUND(SUM(per.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) / SUM(per.NUM_EMPLOYEES), 2)
    END AS AVG_GROSS_SQFT_PER_EMPLOYEE
  FROM per_building per
  GROUP BY
    per.BUILDING_TYPE
)
SELECT
  s.BUILDING_TYPE,
  s.NUM_NOT_SUBDIVISIONS,
  s.NUM_EMPLOYEES,
  s.NUM_UNIQUE_STREET_ADDR,
  s.NUM_UNIQUE_CITY,
  s.NUM_UNIQUE_STATE,
  s.NUM_UNIQUE_POSTAL,
  s.AVG_GROSS_SQFT_PER_EMPLOYEE
FROM summary s

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'TOTAL' AS BUILDING_TYPE,
  SUM(IS_NOT_SUBDIVISION),
  SUM(NUM_EMPLOYEES),
  SUM(UNIQUE_STREET_ADDR),
  SUM(UNIQUE_CITY),
  SUM(UNIQUE_STATE),
  SUM(UNIQUE_POSTAL),
  CASE WHEN SUM(NUM_EMPLOYEES)=0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(SUM(BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE)/SUM(NUM_EMPLOYEES),2) END
FROM per_building

ORDER BY
  -- put TOTAL last
  CASE WHEN BUILDING_TYPE = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  BUILDING_TYPE

rows.question: For each course, list its title, name of the building of the course location, duration (in terms of days), and a running average of the duration (in terms of days) using a window of two preceding and two following courses (partitioned by academic year and sorted by course start date).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH chunk_view_3 AS (
  SELECT
    ss.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    ss.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,
    ss.SUBJECT_ID AS subject_id,
    ss.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
    -- schema does not have meeting/place schedule table. Keep meet_place NULL so join to building yields NULL when unknown.
    NULL AS meet_place,
    -- no per-course start/end in schema, keep NULL so term dates are used instead
    NULL AS iap_date,
    NULL AS iap_end_date,
    ss.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS enroll_warehouse_load_date
  FROM subject_summary ss
)
SELECT
  cv.subject_title AS course_title,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  -- compute start and end using course-level dates when present, otherwise fall back to term-level dates
  DATEDIFF(
    COALESCE(cv.iap_end_date, at.TERM_END_DATE, at.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM),
    COALESCE(cv.iap_date, at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES, at.TERM_START_DATE)
  ) AS duration_days,
  AVG(
    DATEDIFF(
      COALESCE(cv.iap_end_date, at.TERM_END_DATE, at.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM),
      COALESCE(cv.iap_date, at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES, at.TERM_START_DATE)
    )
  ) OVER (
    PARTITION BY COALESCE(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cv.academic_year)
    ORDER BY COALESCE(cv.iap_date, at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES, at.TERM_START_DATE)
    ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
  ) AS running_avg_duration_days
FROM chunk_view_3 cv
LEFT JOIN academic_terms at
  ON cv.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN fclt_building fb
  ON cv.meet_place = fb.BUILDING_NUMBER
ORDER BY COALESCE(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cv.academic_year),
  COALESCE(cv.iap_date, at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES, at.TERM_START_DATE)

rows.question: For each course, list its name, name of the building of the course location, the start date, the name of the course before it, and the name of the course after it, access level of the building, and the assignable area of the room used for the course, sorted by the ascending order start date and course name.

SELECT
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_name,
  COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME, NULL) AS building_name,
  at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES AS start_date,
  (
    SELECT so2.SUBJECT_TITLE
    FROM subject_offered so2
    WHERE so2.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
      AND (
            (so2.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NOT NULL AND so.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NOT NULL AND so2.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT < so.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT)
         OR ( (so2.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NULL OR so.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NULL)
              AND so2.COURSE_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND so.COURSE_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
              AND so2.COURSE_NUMBER < so.COURSE_NUMBER)
      )
    ORDER BY
      CASE WHEN so2.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NOT NULL AND so.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NOT NULL THEN so2.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT END DESC,
      CASE WHEN (so2.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NULL OR so.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NULL) THEN so2.COURSE_NUMBER END DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS previous_course_name,
  (
    SELECT so3.SUBJECT_TITLE
    FROM subject_offered so3
    WHERE so3.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
      AND (
            (so3.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NOT NULL AND so.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NOT NULL AND so3.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT > so.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT)
         OR ( (so3.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NULL OR so.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NULL)
              AND so3.COURSE_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND so.COURSE_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
              AND so3.COURSE_NUMBER > so.COURSE_NUMBER)
      )
    ORDER BY
      CASE WHEN so3.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NOT NULL AND so.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NOT NULL THEN so3.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT END ASC,
      CASE WHEN (so3.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NULL OR so.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT IS NULL) THEN so3.COURSE_NUMBER END ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS next_course_name,
  fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME AS access_level,
  ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS room_assignable_area
FROM subject_offered so
LEFT JOIN academic_terms at
  ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN space_detail sd
  ON sd.BUILDING_ROOM = so.MEET_PLACE
LEFT JOIN fclt_floor ff
  ON ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
     OR ff.LEVEL_ID = sd.FLOOR_KEY
     OR ff.FLOOR = sd.FLOOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN fclt_building fb
  ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
     OR fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = sd.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN buildings b
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
     OR (fb.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER = fb.BUILDING_NUMBER)
ORDER BY
  at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES ASC,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC

rows.question: From the 100 email lists with the most number of subscribers, list their names, their total number of subscribers, their public status, the name of the department with the most presence in the list, and the number of students from this department in the list.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
-- total distinct subscriber count per list (count distinct MIT ids when present, else distinct member strings)
list_member_identity AS (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    -- prefer MIT id when available, otherwise use the raw member string to count unique subscribers
    COALESCE(NULLIF(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, ''), MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS member_identity,
    MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID <> '' AS has_mit_id,
    MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
  FROM moira_list_detail
),
list_totals AS (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT member_identity) AS total_subscribers
  FROM list_member_identity
  GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
-- public status heuristic from list key or owner key
list_status AS (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    -- if any owner key for the list indicates 'public' mark public; else check list key; default private
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY) LIKE '%public%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'public'
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) LIKE '%public%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'public'
      ELSE 'private'
    END AS public_status
  FROM moira_list_detail
  GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
-- attach department/organization for members where MIT_ID exists and se_person has organization info
member_departments AS (
  SELECT
    l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    l.member_identity,
    l.has_mit_id,
    sp.ORGANIZATION AS department_name,
    -- determine student status from available fields: here we only have se_person.IS_ACTIVE/EMPLOYEE_TYPE; the schema lacks explicit student flag,
    -- so treat rows where has_mit_id = true and se_person.EMPLOYEE_TYPE IS NULL or contains 'student' (case-insensitive) as students.
    CASE
      WHEN l.has_mit_id AND (LOWER(COALESCE(sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE,'')) LIKE '%student%') THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_student
  FROM list_member_identity l
  LEFT JOIN se_person sp
    ON l.has_mit_id AND sp.MIT_ID = l.member_identity
),
-- only count members for whom department and student status are recorded as required by the prompt
member_dept_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    department_name,
    is_student
  FROM member_departments
  WHERE department_name IS NOT NULL AND department_name <> ''
),
-- for each list and department, count total members and student members
dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    department_name,
    COUNT(*) AS members_in_dept,
    SUM(is_student) AS students_in_dept
  FROM member_dept_filtered
  GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY, department_name
),
-- pick the department with the max members_in_dept per list (tie-break deterministically by department_name)
top_dept_per_list AS (
  SELECT
    dc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    dc.department_name AS top_department,
    dc.members_in_dept,
    dc.students_in_dept,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY ORDER BY dc.members_in_dept DESC, dc.department_name) AS rn
  FROM dept_counts dc
),
-- top 100 lists by total subscribers
top100_lists AS (
  SELECT
    lt.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    lt.total_subscribers
  FROM list_totals lt
  ORDER BY lt.total_subscribers DESC
  LIMIT 100
)
SELECT
  t.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS list_name,
  t.total_subscribers AS total_subscribers,
  COALESCE(ls.public_status, 'private') AS public_status,
  COALESCE(td.top_department, 'Unknown') AS top_department,
  COALESCE(td.students_in_dept, 0) AS top_department_student_count
FROM top100_lists t
LEFT JOIN list_status ls
  ON t.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN top_dept_per_list td
  ON t.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = td.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AND td.rn = 1
ORDER BY t.total_subscribers DESC
